verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs list authenticator-app (TOTP) and backup codes as second-factor strategies. When MFA is enabled, sign-ins return needs_second_factor, which custom flows must handle. A changelog entry on a customizable reverification window shows step-up enforcement for sensitive actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mandating MFA for all users or org-wide, in-depth step-up and reverification docs beyond a changelog line, and independent hands-on corroboration (community comments mention only that MFA raises cost).
